Cybersecurity Analyst 
 Located in Bucharest, Romania 
 For over 100 years Yokogawa has positioned itself as a supplier of Industrial Automation solutions for the industry continuously increasing the value add for its users through intense customer collaboration, unequalled quality, and solutions that provide well beyond market average returns for its users. Serving customers in virtually any industry Yokogawa has build a network of sales and service throughout the world and is a consistent performer for its customers.
 All the above comes with 5 Core Values:
 Respect, Value Creation, Collaboration, Integrity, Gratitude.
 To further support the growth of Yokogawa in Europe we seek experienced professionals. Thinkers and self-starters who 'See, Know, Act'. Quick, smart, decisive. But above all, willing to go the extra mile for our customers!
 At Yokogawa Europe Solutions, location Bucharest, We are looking for a customer-oriented Cybersecurity Analyst to join our team and support the delivery of cybersecurity solutions for industrial and enterprise environments.
 Key Responsibilities 
Provide cybersecurity consulting and technical support to customers, acting as a trusted advisor throughout the design, implementation, configuration, and optimization of security solutions.
Investigate and resolve complex cybersecurity, infrastructure, and network-related issues, perform root cause analysis, and support incident response , service restoration activities and disaster recovery planning.
Design, implement, maintain, and troubleshoot Microsoft Windows infrastructure services, including Windows Server, Active Directory, Domain Controllers, PKI, WSUS, NPS, and remote access solutions.
Deploy, configure, and support network and security technologies, including firewalls, VPNs, routing, switching, network segmentation, secure remote access, and network hardening.
Implement and manage monitoring solutions for network, infrastructure, and security systems, ensuring availability, performance, and visibility of critical environments.
Support endpoint security, antimalware, application control, backup and recovery solutions, ensuring business continuity and cyber resilience.
Configure and support OT cybersecurity and intrusion detection platforms, analyze security alerts and anomalies, and provide actionable recommendations to mitigate cyber risks.
Implement and troubleshoot multifactor authentication and secure access solutions while supporting customers in strengthening their security posture.
Collaborate with customers, vendors, and internal teams, preparing technical documentation, reports, and implementation guidelines to ensure successful project delivery and operational excellence.
 What We Are Looking For 
Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, IT, Automation, Telecommunications, Electronics, Engineering, or a related field.
Minimum 3 years of experience in cybersecurity, IT/OT infrastructure, network security, system administration, or technical support.
Hands-on experience with Windows infrastructure, networking, security technologies, endpoint protection, backup solutions, and authentication platforms.
Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, customer-focused mindset, and ability to explain technical concepts to different audiences.
Good written and spoken English.
 In accordance with transparency regulations, the specific salary range and full benefits package will be confirmed during the initial recruiter screening 
 Important for us 
 For Yokogawa diversity and inclusion is not just a human resources initiative or social to-do. It is something that we strongly believe and promote. We aim to recruit talent who dare to bring change to our organization with a diverse mindset and refreshing new views.
 Yokogawa wants a Diverse, Equitable, and Inclusive culture.We will actively recruit, develop, and promote people from a variety of backgrounds who differ in terms of experience, knowledge, thinking styles, perspective, cultural background, and socioeconomic status. We will not discriminate based on any categorization of humankind. Yokogawa values differences and enables everyone to belong, contribute, succeed, and demonstrate their full potential.
